## ITEM 7

### (a) Overall probability of an error

```{r}
P_Jane <- 0.10
P_Amy <- 0.30
P_Ava <- 0.60

P_E_given_Jane <- 0.08
P_E_given_Amy <- 0.05
P_E_given_Ava <- 0.01

P_E <- (P_E_given_Jane * P_Jane) +
       (P_E_given_Amy * P_Amy) +
       (P_E_given_Ava * P_Ava)

P_E
```

The overall percentage of error is **2.9%**.

### (b) Most likely person

```{r}
P_Jane_given_E <- (P_E_given_Jane * P_Jane) / P_E
P_Amy_given_E <- (P_E_given_Amy * P_Amy) / P_E
P_Ava_given_E <- (P_E_given_Ava * P_Ava) / P_E

P_Jane_given_E
P_Amy_given_E
P_Ava_given_E
```

Amy is the most likely person to have written the program, with a probability of **51.72%**.
